2607.01938.title: PhysMani: Physics-principled 3D World Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation
2607.01938.paper_summary: Manipulating fast and dynamically moving targets in unstructured 3D environments remains challenging for embodied AI. Existing visual-language-action models and world models struggle with accurate 3D geometry and physically meaningful forecasting. We propose PhysMani, a framework that couples a physics-principled 3D Gaussian world model with a future-aware action policy model. The world model learns a divergence-free Gaussian velocity field via online optimization for fast and physically grounded future dynamics prediction. The policy model integrates the predicted 3D scene future dynamics through a learnable token based cross-attention module. We introduce PhysMani-Bench, a dynamic manipulation benchmark with 16 tasks, and demonstrate a superior success rate over strong baselines in both simulation and real-world robot experiments.
2607.01938.paper_summary_zh: 操控快速且動態移動的目標在非結構化的3D環境中對於具身AI來說仍然具有挑戰性。現有的視覺-語言-行動模型和世界模型在準確的3D幾何和物理意義的預測上面臨困難。我們提出了PhysMani，一個將基於物理的3D高斯世界模型與未來感知的行動策略模型結合的框架。世界模型通過在線優化學習一個無散度的高斯速度場，以便快速且基於物理的未來動態預測。策略模型通過可學習的基於令牌的交叉注意力模塊整合預測的3D場景未來動態。我們推出了PhysMani-Bench，一個包含16個任務的動態操控基準，並在模擬和現實世界的機器人實驗中展示了優於強基準的成功率。
